caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a person standing on a jagged, dark-colored rock formation. The person has light brown skin and dark brown or black hair, and is adorned with a green feathered headdress. They are wearing a short red cape with a yellow clasp, over a light blue garment that covers the torso and one leg, with a green belt around the waist. The legs are decorated with yellow markings, and the person is barefoot, but the feet appear to be wrapped in light yellow cloth. One arm is holding a tomahawk with a brown handle and a light-colored blade, while the other hand is raised to the forehead as if looking into the distance. Draped over the shoulders and extending down the back is a dark blue cloak with green trim. The background is a plain light beige, and there are no additional objects or scenery included in the drawing.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
